sections.title: باب 8 — متن (8)

paras.text: … service is carried out. Therefore in simple words community service means that activity from which the community benefits.
paras.urdu: سروس کروائی جاتی ہے۔ لہٰذا سادہ الفاظ میں کمیونٹی سروس سے مراد وہ سرگرمی ہے جس سے کمیونٹی کو فائدہ پہنچے۔
paras.pashto: … خدمت ترسره کېږي. نو په ساده ټکو له ټولنیز خدمت مراد هغه فعالیت دی چې ټولنې ته ګټه ورسوي.

paras.text: It is the moral responsibility of every inhabitant of a country to come forward for the service of his community. Only filling one’s own belly is not enough for good citizenship. The purpose of life is the name of being of use to others. Every citizen can be of use to the community in the light of his professional skill. Voluntarily he should bring his professional abilities into use for the welfare of the community. In society and community there are such problems whose ending is not only the responsibility of the government. In such matters one’s share can be contributed on a self-help basis or by sharing the government’s hand.
paras.urdu: کسی ملک کے ہر باشندے کی اخلاقی ذمہ داری ہوتی ہے کہ وہ اپنی کمیونٹی کی خدمت کیلئے آگے آئے۔ صرف اپنا پیٹ بھرنا احسن شہریت کیلئے کافی نہیں۔ زندگی کا مقصد اوروں کے کام آنے کا نام ہے۔ ہر شہری اپنے پیشہ ورانہ مہارت کی روشنی میں کمیونٹی کے کام آ سکتا ہے۔ رضاکارانہ طور پر اُسے اپنے پیشہ ورانہ صلاحیتوں کو کمیونٹی کی فلاح و بہبود کیلئے کام میں لانا چاہیئے۔ معاشرہ اور کمیونٹی میں ایسے مسائل ہوتے ہیں جنہیں ختم کرنا صرف حکومت کی ذمہ داری نہیں ہوتی۔ ایسے معاملات میں اپنی مدد آپ کے تحت یا پھر حکومت کا ہاتھ بٹا کر اپنا حصہ ڈالا جا سکتا ہے۔

paras.text: When someone becomes engaged in the service of his community, this is a healthy activity. In the world there are also many institutions which support community service. Among the examples of well-known community service are teaching children, building simple houses for people of low income, serving the old, making shelters for animals, extinguishing fires and providing services in emergencies and service in the beautification of the area etc. Some people are put in community service as punishment, while some render these services with religious zeal. For people newly joined in community service this is a strange experience and an opportunity to learn many things. They realise where and with whom they live. It is also learnt what problems the community faces. In some areas regular institutions are active in community service. Volunteers who are desirous of community service should contact such institutions, or else review the bulletin boards at different places of the area where notices of such institutions are displayed. The internet too can be used to obtain information about such institutions.

… service is carried out. Therefore in simple words community service means that activity from which the community benefits.

It is the moral responsibility of every inhabitant of a country to come forward for the service of his community. Only filling one’s own belly is not enough for good citizenship. The purpose of life is the name of being of use to others. Every citizen can be of use to the community in the light of his professional skill. Voluntarily he should bring his professional abilities into use for the welfare of the community. In society and community there are such problems whose ending is not only the responsibility of the government. In such matters one’s share can be contributed on a self-help basis or by sharing the government’s hand.

When someone becomes engaged in the service of his community, this is a healthy activity. In the world there are also many institutions which support community service. Among the examples of well-known community service are teaching children, building simple houses for people of low income, serving the old, making shelters for animals, extinguishing fires and providing services in emergencies and service in the beautification of the area etc. Some people are put in community service as punishment, while some render these services with religious zeal. For people newly joined in community service this is a strange experience and an opportunity to learn many things. They realise where and with whom they live. It is also learnt what problems the community faces. In some areas regular institutions are active in community service. Volunteers who are desirous of community service should contact such institutions, or else review the bulletin boards at different places of the area where notices of such institutions are displayed. The internet too can be used to obtain information about such institutions.

Many people engage in community service for success in eternal life, the pleasure of God, the attainment of real happiness, the fulfilment of the feeling of comfort in collective life, the spirit of human service and spiritual salvation. However it has many benefits while there is no harm. The pleasure and peace that are in making a shelter for an animal and in serving a weak person are perhaps in nothing else.

Activities

1. Preparing an awareness plan to raise consciousness of cleanliness among people at the local level.

2. Working by mobilising the community for the best environment.

Disaster

Definition:

In life many events occur from the side of nature, while many occur because of our conscious effort, negligence, carelessness and technical fault. In such circumstances the responsibilities of a responsible and active citizen increase. Tragedy, accident or calamity etc. have two basic kinds, i.e. those tragedies which come from the side of nature — the losses of this kind of accident can be reduced — for example earthquake, fire, calamity, epidemic, landslide, flood, storm or the collapse of a building; and those tragedies or events which are committed by man consciously or unconsciously, for example war, terrorism, massacre and blasts etc. Those tragedies and accidents etc. which take place at the hands of man unconsciously are called unconscious tragedies, for example traffic accidents etc.

Disaster Management

Disaster management means that process in which a big event or accident is dealt with in such a way that the public may either be completely saved from its losses or their loss may be reduced to the minimum. Management of a tragedy means identification of the crisis, a plan for dealing with it, and facing and solving it. Its use is generally in international relations, political science and administration. In a tragedy three things are important, i.e. danger, suddenness and surprise, and short time for decision-making. A crisis or tragedy is that process of change in which the old system does not remain intact. Experts have also described disaster management as those special measures which are taken for the solution of the problems created by the crisis.
